memory.title: Global AI memory
memory.lead: Diaries and your companion share this memory. Passages keep the original text for details; relations keep connections for context. Notebook vectors and graphs stay in each notebook and are not merged here.
memory.notebook_notice: Notebook vectors and graphs stay in each notebook and are not merged here.
memory.pending_embed_reminder: {{count}} items are not embedded yet, so search and recall cannot use them
memory.pending_embed_reminder_need_model: {{count}} items are not embedded yet. Configure an embedding model before filling them in.
memory.need_embedding_to_organize: Configure an embedding model next so memory can be organized
memory.need_extract_to_organize: Configure a graph extract model first so memory can be organized
memory.need_models_to_organize: Configure the embedding and graph extract models first so memory can be organized
memory.organize_background_hint: Tip: LLM organization involves multiple passes and may be paused by the system in the background or when locked. Keep the app in the foreground.
memory.organize_incomplete_hint: Previous progress has been saved. Tap "Continue organizing" to resume.
memory.organize_phase_hint: Diaries are embedded first, then their relationship graph is extracted. Partner memories are long-term notes distilled from chats and are embedded separately.

knowledge.title: Knowledge
knowledge.list_subtitle: Topic-isolated notebooks: import sources, then mount them in companion or workbench chat.
knowledge.cover_emoji_keys_office: 办公 office 笔记 book 学习
knowledge.cover_emoji_keys_activity: 活动 activity 旅行 travel
knowledge.empty_notebooks: No notebooks yet. Create a topic container first.
knowledge.detail_subtitle: Manage this notebook's sources. After embedding, mount them in companion or workbench chat.
knowledge.mount_hint: After sources are embedded, you can mount them when chatting with AI in the app.
knowledge.start_chat: Start a conversation with this notebook
knowledge.notebook_mount_hint: Mount up to 3 notebooks. Vector dimensions must match.
knowledge.empty_notes: No notes yet. Save an answer here.
knowledge.import_file_hint: Supports PDF, EPUB, Markdown, and plain text. Scanned or textless PDFs can use local OCR.
knowledge.empty_sources: No sources yet. Import PDF / Markdown / URL.
knowledge.scan_evidence: {{missing}} of {{total}} pages lack a text layer
knowledge.preview_unsupported: This file type cannot be previewed
knowledge.fragment_missing_text: Extracted text is not available yet
knowledge.settings_intro: This controls how text is extracted when you import sources.
knowledge.settings_section_extract_help: Existing text is read first. Missing or garbled pages use local OCR for scans, or a vision model for complex layouts.
knowledge.settings_section_extract_help_mobile: Readable text is taken from the file. PDFs always go to the vision model.
knowledge.extract_hint_garbled: The sampled pages have a damaged text layer. Importing as text will likely produce garbled characters. Choose how to extract text this time.
knowledge.extract_hint_empty: The sampled pages have almost no usable text and look like scans. Choose how to extract text this time.
knowledge.default_engine_hint: Existing text is read first. For missing or garbled pages, prefer local OCR for scans, or a vision model for complex layouts.
knowledge.ocr_language_hint: Used by local OCR only. Falls back to English if the language pack is missing.
knowledge.ocr_concurrency_hint: Pages processed at once, from 1 to 10. 3 is recommended; 1 is safest. Higher values are faster but use more memory and CPU.
knowledge.engine_simple: PDF text layer (fastest; won’t work on scans)
knowledge.vision_model_unset: Not set (falls back to global chat model)
knowledge.vision_model_hint: Any model with image understanding works. Cheaper multimodal models are usually enough. Falls back to the global chat model when unset.
knowledge.vision_model_recommend: A cheaper multimodal model with image understanding is usually enough.
knowledge.vision_model_clear: Clear and follow the global chat model
knowledge.storage_usage: This notebook {{total}} MB, original text {{original}} MB
knowledge.model_mismatch_hard_block: Embedding model does not match knowledge vectors. Rebuild the index first.
knowledge.reset_dont_ask_again_desc: After restoring, opening a notebook will show the current model and extraction status again.
knowledge.graph_title_help: People, places, and events extracted from this notebook’s sources. The life relation graph is a separate store and is not mixed in here.
knowledge.rebuild_graph_confirm: This re-extracts relations in this notebook from current sources. Each source first clears its extracted nodes and relations, then writes the new result. It may take a while. The life relation graph is not changed.
knowledge.reembed_graph_confirm: This re-extracts relations from “{{title}}” with the current graph extract model. It first clears nodes and relations traced to this source, then writes the new result. Vector index is unchanged. It may take a while.
knowledge.rebuild_index_confirm: This rebuilds this notebook’s vector index with the current embedding model. It may take a while and does not generate sync traffic.
knowledge.graph_empty_title: Relations in this notebook have not been organized yet
knowledge.graph_empty_body: Found {{count}} sources to analyze. After organizing, people, places, and events will appear here. The life relation graph is not changed.
knowledge.graph_empty_no_sources: Import sources first, then organize relations in this notebook. The life relation graph is a separate dataset and will not be mixed in.
knowledge.graph_ops_hint: Re-extract only organizes this notebook. The life relation graph is not changed.
knowledge.heavy_confirm_wait: Review the content first. Continue in {{seconds}}s
knowledge.data_manage_clear_intro: Choose derived data to clear. Original files stay. Clearing cannot be undone.
knowledge.data_manage_reprocess_intro: Choose data to reprocess with the current models. This may take a while.
knowledge.delete_notebook_confirm: This deletes "{{name}}" and all of its sources, extracted text, vectors, and notebook graph. The vault files are removed too, so other devices will clear them after sync. This cannot be undone.
knowledge.source_not_embedded: This source has not finished embedding yet. Complete the embedding first, then extract the graph.
knowledge.graph_extract_not_configured: Graph extract model is not configured. Choose one in settings first.
knowledge.extracted_text_missing: This source has no extracted text, so the graph cannot be built.
knowledge.api_not_ready: The knowledge API is not ready. Quit the app completely and reopen it, then try again.
